title: Google Photos Takeout Backup Freshness
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:takeout archive_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by archive_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures Takeout backup lag by archive for Google Photos backups.
value: Lag tracking shows which archive create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside Google Photos backups.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `Takeout backup lag` on `memory:takeout` events and aggregate them by `archive_name`.
visualization: Table of archive with average and worst Takeout backup lag.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how long things take for each archive so you can see where Google Photos backups slows down.
